items.title: Pay roof gutter invoice
items.computation: Invoice date (Rechnungsdatum) is 20.11.2026. The period is triggered by an event (issuance of the invoice), so under §187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of the event itself is not counted; counting starts on 21.11.2026 as day 1. 30 days later (day 30) falls on 20.12.2026. Checking the weekday: counting forward from today (Tue 24.11.2026) shows 20.12.2026 is a Sunday. Since this is a payment deadline governed by civil law, §193 BGB applies: if the last day of a period falls on a Sunday, Saturday, or public holiday, it shifts to the next business day. 21.12.2026 is a Monday and not a public holiday in NW, so the due date shifts to 21.12.2026.
